::: {#sol-load-tensor}

```{python}
#| code-fold: show
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import torch
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

digits = pd.read_csv("data/optdigits-test.csv", header=None)
pixels = digits.iloc[:, :64].to_numpy()
images = torch.tensor(pixels.reshape(-1, 8, 8))
labels = torch.tensor(digits[64].to_numpy())
n_images = len(images)
print(images[0])
print(labels[:10])
```

`torch.tensor` copies a NumPy array into a PyTorch array.
`images` stacks `r py$n_images` grids, each with 8 rows and 8 columns,
and `labels` holds one number per image.

:::
